name: IRC_CMT_LAUNCH_CONTENTS
description: This table stores message content information for the launch.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: BODY_SEARCH_TEXT
columns.description: Message body in plain text for text search

columns.name: SUBJECT_SEARCH_TEXT
columns.description: Subject in plain text for text search

columns.name: LAUNCH_ID
columns.description: Stores LAUNCH_ID. Foreign Key to IRC_CMT_LAUNCH.

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: Stores subject part for the message.

columns.name: BODY
columns.description: Stores body part for the message.

columns.name: COMMON_TOKENS
columns.description: Stores common token values for the launch in JSON format.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SENDER_EMAIL
columns.description: Sender's email address, which will be used to communicate with the sender.

columns.name: SENDER_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: This field holds the display name of the sender.

columns.name: REPLY_TO_EMAIL
columns.description: Email address to which the reply email can be sent.

columns.name: REPLY_TO_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display Name of the email to which the reply email can be sent.

columns.name: IS_DEFAULT
columns.description: Specifies the contents are default if the preferred language is not available.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
